title: Context Package — Pre-digested Knowledge Bundle
description: Structured knowledge bundle that Generator consumes directly without parsing files. Replaces raw file-list approach: instead of 'read patterns/table.md and figure it out', Generator iterates knowledge[].pattern and injects.

confidence.description: Aggregate confidence: min of all knowledge entries + upstream artifacts

context.description: Producer 分工：全部桶由 knowledge-resolver 产出（rules/knowledge/guidance/recommendations）。components/api/artifacts 三个桶已于 2026-09-18 移除——它们**从未有任何 Producer**（resolver 里 0 次 push、planner 无填充指令），属「设计未落地」。恢复条件：Producer + Consumer + Verify 一次性闭环（见 ROADMAP）。

knowledge.description: Metadata pointers to relevant patterns/components/api (P2, recommended). pattern/constraints 正文在方案 B hydrate 阶段注入。

rules.description: Mandatory constraints (rules + project decisions). Always the full set — never dropped by Top-K.

guidance.description: Advisory knowledge (experience/playbooks + task-scope decisions). Reference material, not binding.

recommendations.description: 项目级应然建议（新代码改进方向，非现状规范）。与 knowledge 桶的区别：knowledge 描述「现状是什么」，recommendations 描述「新代码该往哪走」。由 knowledge-resolver 从 recommendations/ 目录产出。

knowledgeEntry.description: Metadata-only pointer（v2.1）。resolver 分桶产出 source + 元数据；pattern/constraints 正文在 hydrate 阶段（方案 B）按需注入，metadata-only 阶段可为空。

capability.description: Capability label from knowledge-index.json（knowledge 桶用）

tags.description: 逗号分隔的标签（Resolver 用 tag 过滤/排序）

pattern.description: [方案 B hydrate] 提取的 convention/pattern 正文，Generator 直接注入。metadata-only 阶段可省略。

constraints.description: [方案 B hydrate] pattern 内的硬约束

anti_pattern.description: [方案 B hydrate] 什么不该做

type.description: rule = team coding rule; decision = project-level ADR. Both default to blocking.

enforcement.description: Source of truth, copied from index metadata.

blocking.description: DERIVED 兼容字段 = (enforcement === 'blocking')。判断逻辑只认 enforcement；blocking 仅向后兼容，禁止出现 A 判 blocking / B 判 enforcement 的双语义。

recommendationEntry.description: 项目级应然建议（analyzer 的 recommendations/ 目录）。与 knowledgeEntry 的区别：knowledgeEntry 描述现状，本类型描述新代码该往哪走。

capability.description: Capability label from knowledge-index.json（恒为 recommendations）

enforcement.description: Copied from index metadata（recommendations 恒为 advisory）

statement.description: 一句可直接注入的改进建议（对应 frontmatter 的 statement）
